tool_args.rationale: Both earlier authoring attempts failed because predict referenced an undefined fit variable. This corrected implementation stores the least-squares parameters at fit time and predicts baseline x_now plus a step-size-scaled cubic function of horizon; all eight paid observations are used, and the benchmark can now run fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The available fine batch has already added three informative rows; the remaining uncertainty can be tested by fitting the full paid dataset before incurring more measurement cost.
It does not capture the observed varying sign and magnitude of the residual relative to x_now across horizons.
The eight points show substantial horizon-dependent curvature; a cubic coefficient is a compact next model to test, with numerical fitting and fresh confirmation deciding adequacy.
It is irrelevant to the observed hysteresis pattern and explicitly should not be purchased.
